_comment: starter-free wave, FEED scout. 10 keys under whatsNew.starter*, for the WhatsNewSheet announcement that every account now includes the full Starter plan at no cost. NEW keys only, no collisions: the existing whatsNew.title/gotIt/sections*/stories*/tabs*/resync* are untouched (title and gotIt are still used; the old four row families are now orphaned but left in place, since the splice script only ADDS). 'Starter' is a plan name and stays untranslated. English uses 'analyzes' to match subscription.planRecommendation, the nearest sibling string ('{{plan}} analyzes up to {{limit}} a day'); the dictionary is mixed US/UK overall so the sibling decides. Input to _splice-fragments.mjs, no --allow-overwrite needed.
